scope.zh-CN: 联查现有任务、调用、审批与操作回执。只读视图，不会重试或批准操作。
scope.en-US: Inspect existing tasks, calls, approvals and action receipts. Read-only: no retries or approvals.

permission.zh-CN: 此视图需要 Agent 运行审计权限。
permission.en-US: Agent run observability permission is required.

search.zh-CN: 按任务内容或 AI 同事标识查找
search.en-US: Search task content or colleague code

loadFailed.zh-CN: 记录加载失败，请刷新重试；当前不展示过期结果。
loadFailed.en-US: Records failed to load. Refresh to retry; stale results are hidden.

empty.zh-CN: 没有匹配的会话任务，请调整条件或完成一次 AI 同事对话。
empty.en-US: No matching tasks. Change the search or complete a colleague conversation.

detailFailed.zh-CN: 无法读取详情，请关闭后重新打开。
detailFailed.en-US: Detail unavailable. Close and reopen to retry.

costHelp.zh-CN: 费用来自 usage 账本。未定价、回执缺失或缓存定价口径不完整时显示未知，不能按 0 元解释。已知费用为配置费率估算，不是供应商账单。
costHelp.en-US: Cost comes from the usage ledger. Missing prices, receipts or complete cache pricing are unknown, not zero. Known amounts are configured-rate estimates, not provider invoices.

conversation.zh-CN: 打开我有权访问的会话

noTrace.zh-CN: 尚未关联到调用记录；不能据此认定未调用模型。
noTrace.en-US: No linked call record. This does not prove no model was called.

noApproval.zh-CN: 未查到审批账本记录；会话内确认与审批账本是不同机制。
noApproval.en-US: No approval-ledger record. In-chat confirmation and approval ledger entries are different mechanisms.

noAction.zh-CN: 未查到操作账本回执，请结合调用详情和实际业务记录核对。
noAction.en-US: No action-ledger receipt. Check call details and actual business records.

truncated.zh-CN: 每类仅展示最近 100 条，请在调用或审批专页进一步查询。
truncated.en-US: Only the latest 100 records per category are shown. Continue in trace or approval views.

unparseable.zh-CN: 当前租户有任务元数据无法读取，已单独排除；以下列表不代表完整任务历史。数量：
unparseable.en-US: Some tenant task metadata is unreadable and excluded. This list is not a complete history. Count:
